note: Claims are each fund's own stated objectives, paraphrased from its annual report. Labels are a preliminary reading of the data, set by a person, not by code.

claims.claim: Aims to pay regular, stable cash distributions.
claims.value: 4.6% (Class I), 4.5% (Class D), 3.8% (Class S); distributions declared monthly
claims.context: Distributions were declared every month in the quarter. Recent years' payouts were classified mainly as return of capital, which matters for tax (see Tax Lens).

claims.claim: Aims to preserve and protect invested capital.
claims.metric: Total return, 2026 to June 30, and since inception (annualized), Class I
claims.value: 5.2% year to date; 9.4% a year since inception
claims.context: Returns over both periods are positive. Capital can still be hard to reach: BREIT limited repurchases at times between late 2022 and early 2024 (see Liquidity Simulator).

claims.claim: Offers lower observed volatility than public real estate companies.
claims.metric: How the value per share is set
claims.value: Monthly, based partly on independent appraisals (each property at least yearly) and reviewed by an independent valuation advisor
claims.context: The claim says "observed" volatility, which is accurate: appraisal-based values move more gradually than traded prices. Lower observed volatility isn't the same as lower risk (see Why So Smooth?).
